votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of November 10, 2022, as well as the formal meeting minutes of October 18, 2022.
votes.description: Approval of two sets of prior meeting minutes: the work session from November 10, 2022 and the formal meeting from October 18, 2022.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance: Rezone, Master Plan Amendment and Alley Vacation at 1550 S Main Street Assemblage.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed rezone, master plan amendment, and alley vacation at 1550 S Main Street and defers a final decision to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on Ordinance: Budget Amendment No. 4 for Fiscal Year 2022-23.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the FY2022-23 Budget Amendment No. 4 and defers adoption to a future Council meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 77 of 2022 Establishing Limits for New Water Availability.
votes.description: Amends City code to expand water use limits prohibiting new commercial or industrial land uses consuming more than 200,000 gallons per day to the City's entire water service area, including neighboring jurisdictions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 44 of 2022 Amending an Interlocal Agreement Between Sandy and Salt Lake City Regarding Computer Aided Dispatch and Record Management System Services.
votes.description: Authorizes an amended and restated interlocal cooperation agreement between Salt Lake City Corporation and Sandy City covering compensation for public safety dispatch, communication, and records management services.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 78 of 2022 Economic Development Loan Fund – Club Verse at 609 South State Street.
votes.description: Approves a $250,000 Economic Development Loan Fund loan to Core Image Investments, LLC - Club Verse, to assist in creating 45 new jobs and retaining 3 current jobs at 609 S State Street.

Approves multiple board reappointments and appointments including Adam Weinacker and Carol Osborn to the Library Board, Jess Bird to the Airport Board, David Quealy as Disciplinary Appeals Hearing Officer, and Marti Woolford and Ebay Hamilton to the Arts Council.
